1. Record your existing PC

Use these choices in the cost worksheetConsider a prebuilt alternative

Keep means you intend to reuse an owned part. Verify leaves its purchase cost unresolved. Cooling, fans, accessories, operating system, tax and shipping still need explicit choices in the worksheet.

2. Compare a specific change

Each phase is a complete interim configuration and is checked again. Unknowns still need exact support evidence. Comparable game or application tests are required before claiming a performance gain.

3. Compare the full platform cost

Include the motherboard, memory, cooler or mounting kit, PSU/cables, operating system and accessories affected by a swap. An empty quote is unknown, not free. Owned parts stay separate from new spending.
